short_release_notes:
Apollo Passive Receive Build 96 tracks KA9Q reception from advancing per-channel RTP counters and requires matching captured PCM before audio reporting. Diagnostic IF display bins no longer merge separate channels or manufacture signal-to-noise evidence. Unknown native measurements remain unknown.

Managed update only. Retains periodic physical provenance renewal and the permanent server-authority/node-agent/normal-sender path. No KA9Q or RF changes.
